evidence.V1: Front and silhouette outline read instantly as a barrel (bulged belly, rolled lip, hoop and nail nubs on both sides, symmetric outline, A15 X/Y error 0.0); top view reads as a hooped ring, so it is readable from all angles.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big bulged stave body, medium chunky gold hoops and rolled top lip, small hex ink nails (4 per hoop) that the earlier version lacked.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised barrel: pronounced belly, thick gold bands and an over-rounded lip give a chunky toy read, with no stiff-primitive look; nothing floating (nails seated, gap 0).
evidence.V4: Hoops carry a consistent chamfer that catches a highlight band on their top and bottom edges, the lip is rounded and the nails are bevelled hex heads; bevel scale looks consistent across parts.
evidence.V5: Visible minor artifact: the inner edge of the opening is wavy/notched rather than a clean ring (top view, lid close-up), and a light pinch highlight sits on the inner lip at the top of the lid studio close-up; the stave body and hoops themselves shade cleanly.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one wood hue in about three values (light stave, dark stave, dark interior) plus gold accent and ink-dark nails; the painted colourways keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 1728 tris against a medium-class target of 2000 (ceiling 4000), at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold for hoops, ink-dark nails, warm brown as the single hue, smooth shading with chamfered edges; matches the kit style of the pipe anchor.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Anchored, Hull collision (or Cylinder part), CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates A1-A18 pass.
